## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: cluster of large-cap Tech/Financials BELOW TREND (MSFT (1W: -0.45% | 1M: -8.56%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.64% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND) and limited sector participation with Healthcare and Utilities among the few positives; Leadership concentrated (3/5 Materials in Top 5), so be tactically cautious.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: NEM (1W: +12.09% | 1M: -3.99%) RECOVERY, FCX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: -6.66%) RECOVERY. Real Estate showing strength: CCI (1W: +5.03% | 1M: -9.33%) RECOVERY. Healthcare constructive: PFE (1W: +4.66% | 1M: +7.41%) ABOVE TREND, BMY (1W: +4.73% | 1M: +0.83%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy lagging: CVX (1W: -3.77% | 1M: +4.58%) CORRECTION and XOM (1W: -1.52% | 1M: +5.89%) CORRECTION. Technology weak: MSFT (1W: -0.45% | 1M: -8.56%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.64% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary soft, led lower by NKE (1W: -15.76% | 1M: -24.85%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: NEM (1W: +12.09% | 1M: -3.99%) RECOVERY; FCX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: -6.66%) RECOVERY; NUE (1W: +5.54% | 1M: -1.74%) RECOVERY; CCI (1W: +5.03% | 1M: -9.33%) RECOVERY; PANW (1W: +4.86% | 1M: +2.93%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Materials) — narrow advance.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CVX (1W: -3.77% | 1M: +4.58%) CORRECTION; AMAT (1W: -4.21% | 1M: +0.71%) CORRECTION; AMD (1W: -4.57% | 1M: +10.09%) CORRECTION; CSCO (1W: -4.77% | 1M: -1.30%) BELOW TREND; LRCX (1W: -4.90% | 1M: +2.30%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in select Tech names and staples like UL/PM.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: NEM (1W: +12.09% | 1M: -3.99%) RECOVERY, FCX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: -6.66%) RECOVERY, NUE (1W: +5.54% | 1M: -1.74%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +4.86% | 1M: +2.93%) ABOVE TREND, BMY (1W: +4.73% | 1M: +0.83%) ABOVE TREND. Watch divergences: AMAT (1W: -4.21% | 1M: +0.71%) CORRECTION despite bullish DRAM headlines.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech shows internal strain with major caps BELOW TREND and mixed mid-cap moves: MSFT (1W: -0.45% | 1M: -8.56%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.64% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND, PANW (1W: +4.86% | 1M: +2.93%) ABOVE TREND — sector under pressure, watch for clustered confirmations before redeploying.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials marginally positive on the week but internals weak: JPM (1W: -0.01% | 1M: -1.63%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.10% | 1M: -6.96%) BELOW TREND — sector breadth limited, so gains are fragile and skewed to select names.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is one of the few constructive sectors: PFE (1W: +4.66% | 1M: +7.41%) ABOVE TREND, BMY (1W: +4.73% | 1M: +0.83%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +4.17% | 1M: -5.28%) RECOVERY — defensive positioning with actionable momentum in specific names.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Given RISK-OFF and narrow leadership, favor selective Healthcare (PFE, BMY) and Materials names showing short-term recovery while reducing exposure to large-cap Tech/consumer discretionary that are BELOW TREND (MSFT, NVDA, NKE). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; keep positions tactical and watch for confirmation before expanding beta.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PANW (1W: +4.86% | 1M: +2.93%) ABOVE TREND; PFE (1W: +4.66% | 1M: +7.41%) ABOVE TREND; NEM (1W: +12.09% | 1M: -3.99%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: NKE (1W: -15.76% | 1M: -24.85%) BELOW TREND; MSFT (1W: -0.45% | 1M: -8.56%) BELOW TREND; NVDA (1W: -1.64% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (showing short-term recoveries) and Healthcare (select names ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Technology (major caps BELOW TREND), Consumer Discretionary (NKE stress), Energy on pullback despite 1M gains — watch for follow-through.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -1.64% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND — break above recent 1M highs would be needed to shift regime risk. AAPL (1W: +1.19% | 1M: -3.08%) RECOVERY — watch 1W follow-through to validate reversal. PFE (1W: +4.66% | 1M: +7.41%) ABOVE TREND — failure to hold weekly gains would signal rotation out of Healthcare.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
PANW (+55): Upgrade to Buy headline; PANW (1W: +4.86% | 1M: +2.93%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming price. LLY (+80): GLP-1 pill/AI partnership; LLY (1W: +4.17% | 1M: -5.28%) RECOVERY — sentiment supports the 1W move but 1M lag remains, watch follow-through. AMAT (+55): DRAM price surge headline; AMAT (1W: -4.21% | 1M: +0.71%) CORRECTION — news positive but 1W price weakness is a divergence. NVDA (+50): upbeat Q comments; NVDA (1W: -1.64% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND — positive headlines but price is lagging, a notable divergence.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
NKE (-55): China weakness headline; NKE (1W: -15.76% | 1M: -24.85%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirms distribution and heightens downside risk. (Few other top negative headlines lack dual timeframe data in today's packet; monitor AMGN/PG/PYPL news flows if position exposure exists.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, style mixed / no clear leadership. PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.66% | 1M: +7.41%) and PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.86% | 1M: +2.93%) are showing relative strength while Materials names (NEM RECOVERY) are driving the narrow advance. Key risk: major Tech and financial caps (MSFT (1W: -0.45% | 1M: -8.56%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.64% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND) remain weak and news-flow (NVDA positive headlines) is diverging from price — watch for trend breaks.
